description: I was born & raised in India, where I graduated from Medical school as an ophthalmologist. Arranged marriage brought me to the United States, where my education wasn't recognized. So I earned my PhD. in Molecular Medicine from HMC, Penn State University, and Master in Health Administration (MHA) from PSU Capitol campus. I am currently running for State Representative in PA District 106. Please visit "Citizens for Dr. Anju SIngh" to learn more about me and my stance on important issues.
title: Citizens for Dr. Anju Singh | Anju Singh
